title: Mont Lin Ma Yar
description: Mont Lin Ma Yar is a dish from Myanmar prepared with rice flour, coconut milk, quail egg, green onion. This is a home-scale version with measured ingredients in the individual steps where they are used. Use a takoyaki-style or other small round-cavity pan for the characteristic paired half-moon cakes.

steps.instruction: Whisk the listed batter ingredients until smooth. Let the mixture rest briefly so the flour hydrates.
Spoon the batter into the lightly oiled half-round wells of a special pan; when set, pair two halves around the cooked quail egg filling.
Arrange the already cooked and prepared components for serving, keeping hot and cold components at their safe temperatures.
Finish with the listed ingredients, check seasoning and serve immediately.
